digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync and reconciler command routing
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must run a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass without invoking or reimplementing reconcile-check.

Canonical preview must be lock-free: it loads a read-only snapshot and produces its manifest without acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing the pass lock, while legacy reconcile-check remains independently lock-free through its existing diagnostic branch.

Legacy reconcile-check with --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and output/exit behavior unchanged.

The argparse engine parser must set allow_abbrev=False so that undocumented prefix abbreviations and unknown options fail with invocation error 2 before any repository or lock mutation, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live retains a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE through CLI/library/MCP retains the historical tally-only/no-manifest contract.

Existing capped canonical sync and legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions must remain unchanged; documentation must explicitly distinguish canonical retained manifests from legacy uncapped LIVE deletion behavior.
